entries.updatedReason: Cross-referenced third-party consultancy pages and Wikipedia/Wikidata: 'Euroregional Teaching University LLC' (Gori, Georgia) is documented as the post-2017 rebrand of 'Sukhishvili (Sukhishvii) Teaching University', domain sukhishvilebi.edu.ge. That domain no longer serves the university (Wayback CDX shows it redirecting/dying after 2013 and now resolves to a registrar parking page, confirmed via live snapshot). The only recoverable Wayback snapshot with real content (2011-2012, archive.org) shows the pre-rebrand 'Sukhishvili Teaching University' identity and logo (https://web.archive.org/web/20120206235041im_/http://www.sukhishvilebi.edu.ge/gfx/logo.jpg, resolves 200), not the current Euroregional name/branding. Attaching that 13+ year old pre-rebrand logo to the current record would misattribute identity across a rename. No current official domain for 'Euroregional Teaching University' could be confirmed. Needs a human decision on whether the old Sukhishvili identity is an acceptable stand-in or whether the record should stay unmedia'd pending a live official source.

No media sourced pending that decision.
